title: Canonical derived direct-image spectrum coordinate isomorphisms
statement: For affine schemes X and S and a morphism f:X → S, construct a natural isomorphism Rf_* ≅ L(isoSpec_X.inv)^* followed by R(Spec.map f.appTop)_* followed by L(toSpecΓ_S)^*. Construct also the inverse spectrum pullback equivalence, the forward pullback naturality comparison, and the resulting source comparison after any g:Sprime → S with Sprime affine. All data use the selected pullback composition and pinned adjunctions, not arbitrary existence witnesses.

source.place: Remark 20.28.3, counit definition of base change; Tag 0D5S, Lemma 20.27.2, pullback composition

proof.text: Construct the inverse spectrum pullback equivalence by Equivalence.mk from the composition comparisons for the spectrum iso and its inverse and the identity comparison.

Conjugate the pullback coordinate comparison under the composite pinned adjunction and inverse spectrum equivalence adjunction on each side. Insert the inverse spectrum equivalence unit and whisker to obtain the right-adjoint coordinate iso. Forward naturality and pullback composition then give the source iso.

proof_origin.place: Conjugation and coherence argument for the affine reduction in parent node

def affineSpectrumDerivedDirectImageIso {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine S] (f : X ⟶ S) :
    schemeDerivedDirectImage f ≅
      derivedPullback X.isoSpec.inv ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map f.appTop) ⋙ derivedPullback S.toSpecΓ
